head.t: GE HealthCare adds Lung Guidance and AutoAS artificial intelligence tools to Vscan Air SL handheld ultrasound
head.x: GE HealthCare announced two features for the Vscan Air SL on 03/11/2026: Lung Guidance (probe guidance across the eight-zone lung protocol, with B-line detection and scoring) and AutoAS (a diagnostic aid flagging possible moderate-to-severe aortic stenosis from at least two views).

head.t: Nottingham University Hospitals partners with GE HealthCare
head.x: A memorandum of understanding has been signed by Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust, the University of Nottingham, and GE HealthCare, forming a partnership on research and health innovation.
